state:
Goal `core-queue-stats`: `Core\Queue\Stats::attempts` is finished — `bun nv proofs --id 'Core\Queue\Stats::attempts'` owes nothing, and its figure is in `docs/perf/members.ndjson`.
The shared fixtures are on disk: `benches/members/core/Queue-Stats/nvs.toml` serves every bench of the class, while an example or an attack needs its own copy of `docs/examples/core/Queue-Stats/attempts/nvs.toml` in its member directory.
The Rust half of each member goes in `crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/queue_sqlite.rs` after `sqlite_attempts_sum_every_state_of_one_queue_and_nothing_of_another`, reading its column with `counts(&reader)[i]`. The Novis half goes in a `.nvst` case with a `// covers:` marker, which an instance member needs.
No attack has found a bug yet. Text, fractions, bytes and a sum past `i64::MAX` all throw an `IOError` that the program catches.
